cues.en: Mike: In this video, you are going to learn how to organize and also how to visualize all of the pairwise correlations or covariances across all of the variables,
cues.zh: Mike：這支影片要教你，如何整理與視覺化所有變數之間的成對相關或共變異數，

cues.en: pairwise all the variables in your dataset.
cues.zh: 也就是資料集中所有變數的兩兩配對。

cues.en: So let's get started.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: It's gonna be a pretty fun lecture.
cues.zh: 這會是相當有趣的一堂課。

cues.en: So imagine we have three variables like this.
cues.zh: 假設有像這樣的三個變數。

cues.en: I'm depicting these as time series because I simulated them as time series data.
cues.zh: 我把它們畫成時間序列，因為模擬時就是時間序列資料。

cues.en: You can imagine, you know, maybe these are temperature fluctuations, or maybe these are fluctuations in how much time people spend wasting time on the internet,
cues.zh: 你可以想像它們是溫度波動，或人們浪費時間上網的時數波動，

cues.en: on YouTube, watching videos of cats, or I don't know what people do.
cues.zh: 在 YouTube 看貓咪影片，或其他我也不知道大家會做的事。

cues.en: Anyway, so here we have three variables.
cues.zh: 總之，這裡有三個變數。

cues.en: That's the point.
cues.zh: 重點就是這樣。

cues.en: And we wanna see how all of these variables are pairwise correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 我們想知道所有變數彼此兩兩之間的相關。

cues.en: So we can correlate green with orange, green with blue, and orange with blue.
cues.zh: 可以計算綠色與橘色、綠色與藍色，以及橘色與藍色的相關。

cues.en: So that gives us three possible unique correlations that we can compute here.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡可以計算三個不同的相關。

cues.en: So I'm gonna organize this in a table where we have time series or variable one, variable two, variable three, and one, two, three here as well.
cues.zh: 我把它整理成表格，這裡有時間序列或變數 1、變數 2、變數 3，這邊也是 1、2、3。

cues.en: Okay, so first of all, we can already fill out this, the diagonal of this matrix here.
cues.zh: 首先，矩陣的對角線已經可以填出來。

cues.en: So one, one, correlating one and one, two and two and three, and three.
cues.zh: 1 與 1、2 與 2，以及 3 與 3 的相關。

cues.en: Now, you know, we don't even have to bust out a calculator to do that.
cues.zh: 甚至不用拿出計算機。

cues.en: You know that the correlation of every variable with itself is exactly equal to one.
cues.zh: 你知道，每個變數與自己的相關，都精確等於 1。

cues.en: Okay, so then I actually did...
cues.zh: 接著我實際上做了……

cues.en: You know, these lines come from matlab.
cues.zh: 這些線來自 MATLAB。

cues.en: I simulated these on a computer so that I could actually compute the correlation coefficients between all these pairs.
cues.zh: 我在電腦上模擬它們，才能實際計算所有配對之間的相關係數。

cues.en: So I got these numbers.
cues.zh: 於是得到這些數字。

cues.en: So this, 0.67, is the correlation between variable one and variable two.
cues.zh: 這個 0.67 是變數 1 與變數 2 之間的相關。

cues.en: In other words, the correlation between the blue line and the green line, and so on for these other two variable pairs.
cues.zh: 換句話說，是藍線與綠線之間的相關；另外兩組變數也以此類推。

cues.en: Now, these ones, I've left blank here, these boxes in the table.
cues.zh: 表格中這些格子，我先留白。

cues.en: What do you think?
cues.zh: 你覺得呢？

cues.en: Without, you know, doing any calculations, what do you think those values are going to be?
cues.zh: 不用計算，你認為那些值會是多少？

cues.en: So keep in mind that what we're doing here is correlating variable two with variable one.
cues.zh: 記住，這裡是在計算變數 2 與變數 1 的相關。

cues.en: So the question is, what number is gonna go here?
cues.zh: 問題是，這裡要放什麼數字？

cues.en: This is when we correlate variable two with variable one.
cues.zh: 這是變數 2 與變數 1 的相關。

cues.en: Well, I actually just said the answer.
cues.zh: 其實我剛剛已經說出答案了。

cues.en: So in fact, this matrix is what we call symmetric.
cues.zh: 這個矩陣其實就是所謂的對稱矩陣。

cues.en: That means that when you think of the diagonal here, so this is the diagonal of the matrix, then all of the elements above the diagonal
cues.zh: 也就是以這裡的矩陣對角線來看，對角線上方

cues.en: and to the right are going to exactly mirror the elements below and to the left.
cues.zh: 與右方的所有元素，都會精確鏡射下方與左方的元素。

cues.en: So we have these two are the same, these two are the same, and these two are the same.
cues.zh: 這兩個相同，這兩個相同，這兩個也相同。

cues.en: And this is not some weird feature of having three variables.
cues.zh: 這並不是因為剛好只有三個變數，才出現的奇怪特性。

cues.en: You can have three bajillion variables and you're still going to get a perfectly symmetric matrix.
cues.zh: 就算有極大量的變數，仍然會得到完全對稱的矩陣。

cues.en: And that should also make sense conceptually, because correlation is a symmetric measure.
cues.zh: 概念上也應該合理，因為相關是對稱的指標。

cues.en: So the correlation between blue and green is the same thing as the correlation between green and blue.
cues.zh: 藍色與綠色的相關，和綠色與藍色的相關相同。

cues.en: So that's an intuitive explanation.
cues.zh: 這是直覺上的解釋。

cues.en: We can also explain this arithmetically, and that's by looking at this formula and just swapping the X's and the Y's.
cues.zh: 也可以用算術解釋：看著這個公式，把 X 與 Y 對調。

cues.en: So the form or the result of this formula isn't going to change at all if you say X times Y versus Y times X.
cues.zh: X 乘 Y 或 Y 乘 X，並不會改變公式的形式或結果。

cues.en: So that is totally arbitrary, the ordering here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡的順序完全任意。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the correlation matrix, but you now know that the correlation matrix or computing a correlation is actually the second step.
cues.zh: 這是相關矩陣，但你現在知道，相關矩陣，或相關的計算，其實是第二步。

cues.en: The first step is to compute a covariance.
cues.zh: 第一步是計算共變異數。

cues.en: So what is it going to...
cues.zh: 那麼，它會……

cues.en: What is the covariance matrix going to look like of these, this dataset, these three variables here.
cues.zh: 這份資料集，也就是這三個變數，其共變異數矩陣會長什麼樣子？

cues.en: So I also calculated that, and this is the result.
cues.zh: 我也算好了，這就是結果。

cues.en: So this is the covariance matrix for these data.
cues.zh: 這是這些資料的共變異數矩陣。

cues.en: Now, are you surprised at the diagonal?
cues.zh: 你對對角線感到驚訝嗎？

cues.en: Maybe you would've expected that the diagonal should also be one, right?
cues.zh: 也許你原本預期對角線也應該是 1，對吧？

cues.en: Because we're computing the covariance of a variable with itself.
cues.zh: 因為計算的是一個變數與自己的共變異數。

cues.en: So shouldn't that also be one?
cues.zh: 那不也應該是 1 嗎？

cues.en: Well, the answer is no, obviously, because I have...
cues.zh: 答案顯然不是，因為我這裡……

cues.en: It's not equal to one on these slides.
cues.zh: 投影片上並不等於 1。

cues.en: And to understand why the diagonals of a covariance matrix are not necessarily equal to one, in other words, why the covariance of a variable
cues.zh: 要理解為什麼共變異數矩陣的對角線不一定是 1，也就是為什麼一個變數

cues.en: with itself is not equal to one, we can go back and consider this formula.
cues.zh: 與自己的共變異數不等於 1，可以回頭看這個公式。

cues.en: So this was a formula for a covariance that I showed a couple of videos ago.
cues.zh: 這是幾支影片之前展示的共變異數公式。

cues.en: Now, let's imagine that we are computing the covariance of a variable with itself.
cues.zh: 現在想像計算的是一個變數與自己的共變異數。

cues.en: So set X or or Y to be equal to X.
cues.zh: 把 X，或者說把 Y 設為等於 X。

cues.en: So this is X sub I minus X bar times X sub I minus X bar.
cues.zh: 這裡就是 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值，乘以 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值。

cues.en: So this term and this term are identical.
cues.zh: 這一項與這一項完全相同。

cues.en: So that means we can just, you know, reduce this a little bit and make it look like XI minus X bar squared.
cues.zh: 所以可以稍微簡化，寫成 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值的平方。

cues.en: So get rid of this term and square this term.
cues.zh: 去掉這一項，把這一項平方。

cues.en: And now, does that look familiar at all?
cues.zh: 現在，看起來熟悉嗎？

cues.en: If we have one over N minus one times the square, the sum of XI minus X bar squared.
cues.zh: 1 除以 N 減 1，乘上 Xᵢ 減 X 平均值的平方總和。

cues.en: Where have we seen that formula before?
cues.zh: 我們以前在哪裡看過這個公式？

cues.en: Oh yeah, that was exactly, literally exactly the formula for the variance of a variable.
cues.zh: 對，這正好就是一個變數的變異數公式，完全一樣。

cues.en: So in fact, when we are computing co variance of a variable with itself, that's like...
cues.zh: 因此，計算一個變數與自己的共變異數，就像是……

cues.en: You could call it the the auto covariance, or you could just drop the co part and call it variance.
cues.zh: 你可以稱它為自共變異數，也可以直接去掉「共」，叫作變異數。

cues.en: So covariance, the formula for covariance, literally comes right out of the formula for the variance.
cues.zh: 所以，共變異數的公式，直接來自變異數公式。

cues.en: So the covariance of a variable with itself is just the variance.
cues.zh: 一個變數與自己的共變異數，就是變異數。

cues.en: And that's another way to explain the denominator here, the normalization terms in the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這也是理解相關係數分母，也就是正規化項的另一種方式。

cues.en: So we are normalizing by the variance of X and the variance of Y.
cues.zh: 我們用 X 的變異數與 Y 的變異數來正規化。

cues.en: And again, the N, one over N minus one is missing here, but that's just because we don't need it because it ends up canceling out with the one over N minus one in the numerator.
cues.zh: 這裡同樣少了 1 除以 N 減 1，因為不需要，它最後會與分子中的 1 除以 N 減 1 抵消。

cues.en: Okay, so now we can go back here.
cues.zh: 現在回到這裡。

cues.en: So in fact, the diagonals of a covariance matrix are telling us about the variance of each variable.
cues.zh: 共變異數矩陣的對角線，其實告訴我們各個變數的變異數。

cues.en: And now you can look at these numbers and map that onto what you can see visually here on the lines.
cues.zh: 現在可以看看這些數字，再對照這些線的視覺樣貌。

cues.en: And then it should also make sense.
cues.zh: 這樣應該也就合理了。

cues.en: So the blue line is the least variable, it's wiggling around the least, and then the orange line is wiggling around more, and the green line has the most variance,
cues.zh: 藍線的變動最小，起伏最少；橘線的起伏比較大，而綠線的變異數最大，

cues.en: it has the most extreme points of these three lines.
cues.zh: 在這三條線中，它具有最極端的點。

cues.en: Okay, so I hope you also found this enlightening to see the relationship between the covariance between two variables as being an extension of the variance
cues.zh: 希望這能讓你有所啟發：兩個變數之間的共變異數，可以看成一個變數

cues.en: of a variable with itself.
cues.zh: 與自己之間的變異數的延伸。

cues.en: And then we have the denominator or the normalization term of the correlation coefficient is basically just the variance of each variable X and Y.
cues.zh: 相關係數的分母，也就是正規化項，基本上就是 X 與 Y 各自的變異數。

cues.en: Okay, so another thing we can do with these correlation matrices, and also covariance matrices of course, is color them.
cues.zh: 我們還可以替相關矩陣上色，當然，共變異數矩陣也可以。

cues.en: So what we're going to do now is color scale, or color code, this matrix so that each individual square
cues.zh: 現在要用色階，也就是顏色編碼這個矩陣，讓每個小方格

cues.en: gets colored according to a value related to the intensity of the correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 依據相關係數強度對應的數值著色。

cues.en: So in this one we have cooler colors.
cues.zh: 這裡有較冷的色彩。

cues.en: So blue colors are, you know, closer to, let's say, correlation of 0.4.
cues.zh: 例如藍色，代表比較接近 0.4 的相關。

cues.en: So that's a weaker correlation.
cues.zh: 那是較弱的相關。

cues.en: And then more yellowish colors get a larger correlation.
cues.zh: 偏黃色則表示較大的相關。

cues.en: Now, this way of coloring a correlation matrix or a covariance matrix is useful, particularly for larger matrices.
cues.zh: 這種替相關矩陣或共變異數矩陣上色的方式，尤其適合較大的矩陣。

cues.en: If you only have three variables, you don't really need to color them because you can just print the numbers.
cues.zh: 如果只有三個變數，其實不必上色，因為可以直接印出數字。

cues.en: But imagine if we had 30 variables, then we would have a 30 by 30 matrix, and it's just not convenient to print out the correlation coefficients as numbers
cues.zh: 但假設有 30 個變數，就會有 30 乘 30 的矩陣，要在每個儲存格、

cues.en: in each individual cell, in each little box.
cues.zh: 每個小格子中印出相關係數，就不方便了。

cues.en: So coloring is actually pretty convenient for larger matrices.
cues.zh: 因此，較大的矩陣用上色方式很方便。

cues.en: So here's an example of that.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: Here I have 20 different channels of simulated time series data, and this is what the co variance matrix looks like.
cues.zh: 這裡有 20 個不同通道的模擬時間序列資料，這是共變異數矩陣的樣子。

cues.en: So this is a pretty nice looking plot.
cues.zh: 這張圖相當漂亮。

cues.en: And you can also see this is symmetric.
cues.zh: 也可以看到它是對稱的。

cues.en: We're not sort of proving it as well with the colors, as it was easy to see with the numbers, but you can still see that this is a symmetric matrix.
cues.zh: 顏色不像數字那麼容易看出來，無法同樣清楚地證明，但仍可以看到這是對稱矩陣。

cues.en: So here is the diagonal.
cues.zh: 這裡是對角線。

cues.en: This contains the variances of each individual channel, and then the upper right elements are mirrored with the lower left elements.
cues.zh: 裡面是各通道的變異數，而右上方的元素與左下方元素互為鏡像。

cues.en: So in this video you learned about organizing correlations and covariances from multivariate data sets into matrices.
cues.zh: 這支影片學到，如何把多變量資料集的相關與共變異數整理成矩陣。

cues.en: You learned why correlation matrices and correlations more generally are symmetric.
cues.zh: 也學到相關矩陣，以及一般的相關，為什麼具有對稱性。

cues.en: So correlating A with B is the same thing as correlating B with A.
cues.zh: 也就是 A 與 B 的相關，等於 B 與 A 的相關。

cues.en: And I hope you also got some more insight into the relationship between covariance and variance and correlations.
cues.zh: 希望你也更了解共變異數、變異數與相關之間的關係。
